paper_screening.selection_rule: prefer method diversity and readable evidence over award label alone

route.Q1: LASSO + Pearson + RandomForest + Mutual Information -> weighted voting -> high-correlation backward filtering -> 20 variables
route.Q2: HGBRT regression; compare SVR/MLP/RF etc.; K-fold CV + grid search
route.Q3: HGBCT; class-imbalance penalty C; compare SVM/RF/MLP/AdaBoost/DecisionTree
route.Q4: HGBRT + HGBCT dual-objective formulation -> NSGA-III; lambda preference parameter

strengths: Q1 explicitly combines linear and nonlinear feature evidence rather than relying on one importance score
Q2 has model comparison and hyperparameter search
Q3 recognizes class imbalance and introduces a penalty mechanism
Q4 provides a clear multi-objective evolutionary optimization chain
risks: Q3 ultimately emphasizes Accuracy despite class imbalance; metrics such as balanced accuracy, F1, PR-AUC should also be considered
Q4 manually assigns ADMET combination utility scores (10/8/5/2/1/0), introducing an artificial utility scale
Q4 searches inside descriptor min-max ranges without proving that arbitrary descriptor combinations correspond to realizable molecules
paper itself notes the simplifying independence assumption may conflict with physical/chemical coupling

route.Q1: data cleaning + Spearman filtering -> RandomForest built-in importance + permutation importance + SHAP -> 20 variables
route.Q2: 12 regression models -> LightGBM selected; SHAP cross-check; GridSearchCV
route.Q3: WOE/IV feature screening + oversampling -> 13 classifiers; XGBoost for Caco-2/CYP3A4/hERG, RandomForest for HOB/MN; 10-fold CV
route.Q4: multi-objective optimization -> PSO Pareto set -> goal-programming/primary-objective cross-check

strengths: Q1 combines predictive importance with post-hoc interpretability
Q2 conducts broad model competition instead of selecting an algorithm a priori
Q3 allows different ADMET labels to use different best classifiers
Q3 uses multiple classification metrics and 10-fold cross-validation
Q4 adds a second optimization method as a consistency check
risks: the exact placement of oversampling relative to cross-validation must be checked to rule out leakage
Q4 still optimizes in descriptor space and does not establish molecular realizability of all candidate combinations
paper explicitly observes PSO can fall into local optima and is parameter-sensitive
large model menus can become algorithm stacking unless selection logic and statistical uncertainty are made explicit
